purpose: Express relief or satisfaction about what happened.
keywords: て-form + よかった; negative なくてよかった.
I am glad we left early.
I am glad I could see everyone.
I am glad we did not get caught in the rain.
formation: て-form + よかった; negative なくてよかった.
restrictions: The speaker evaluates an actual outcome; this is not ordinary advice about a future action.
mistake: Do not confuse てよかった with たほうがいい.
